data.name: Plummeting Charge
data.description: If an airborne ambusher flies at least half its fly speed as part of a charge, it gains a +%1 racial bonus on the attack roll (in addition to the normal charge bonus) and a +%2 bonus on its critical confirmation roll.|2+if(FighterLVL>=17,2,0)|4+if(FighterLVL>=17,2,0)
